description: Updated multi-candidate evidence matrix. Phase 7: Multi-Candidate Differentiability Screening. Comprehensive evaluation of ALL optimization candidates across all advisor-required dimensions.

M1_tile16.name: tile_size=16 (default)
M1_tile16.note: Default config. Full 30K training complete on room.

M1_tile32.name: tile_size=32 (optimized)
M1_tile32.mechanism: 32×32 pixel tiles, 1024 threads/block, 108×60 blocks at 1080p. 4× fewer blocks than tile16.
M1_tile32.performance_note: A100: 1.42-3.93x inference, 1.22x training. RTX 5070 room: 1.58x training. RTX 5070 outdoor: 0.69x (SLOWER). Scene and hardware dependent.
M1_tile32.gradient_note: VERIFIED 2026-09-01: gradcheck PASS on all 5 param groups. FD max_abs_error=0.0 (xyz,scales,rotations,opacity). Gradients identical within FP precision.
M1_tile32.gt_quality_note: Pixel-identical on bicycle, garden. Room: max 0.002 pixel diff (FP reduction order). PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS deltas = 0.0.
M1_tile32.training_note: Room 30K: 94.8min vs 150.3min (+58% speedup), 29.39dB vs 29.27dB PSNR. Bicycle/garden OOM on 8GB GPU.
M1_tile32.composability_note: No interaction with M2/M3/M4/M5 in performance. Gradient interactions untested for combined modules (no module combination that makes sense).

M2.name: packed/dense
M2.mechanism: Packed: compaction kernel removes invisible Gaussians. Dense: all Gaussians processed.
M2.performance_note: Inference: 2.02x packed. Training: 1.03x (NO-OP for single-camera training).
M2.gt_quality_note: Bit-identical pixels between packed and dense.
M2.training_note: Full 30K room: packed 62.2min/31.36dB vs dense 64.3min/31.29dB. Nearly identical trajectories.
M2.composability_note: All gates PASS. But NO-OP effect means composability with other modules is irrelevant.

M3.name: SH degree (0/1/3)
M3.mechanism: SH coefficient count: SH0=1, SH1=4, SH3=16 bases. Affects color representation capacity.
M3.performance_note: Inference: <4% timing impact. Training: dominant cost is optimizer (scales with SH param count). SH0: 38.1min, SH3: 68.7min. Not a rendering performance knob.
M3.gt_quality_note: SH0 vs SH3: ΔPSNR 3.9dB, view-dependent appearance degrades. Quality trade-off, not correctness issue.
M3.training_note: Full 30K room: SH0 38.1min/32.34dB, SH1 42.8min/32.22dB, SH3 68.7min/31.44dB. All stable, zero NaN/Inf.
M3.composability_note: All gates PASS. Eligible for composability. But NOT a performance knob for training acceleration.

M4.name: radius_clip
M4.mechanism: Filters Gaussians with both axis radii ≤ threshold during projection. Excluded from tile intersection.
M4.performance_note: <1% intersection reduction at quality-preserving thresholds (rclip≤2.0). rclip=5.0 removes 22.5% Gaussians but only 5.8% tile intersections.
M4.training_note: No workload reduction at quality-preserving thresholds. Training would not reveal benefit.

M5.name: eps2d
M5.mechanism: Additive epsilon to 2D covariance diagonal. Modifies conic, radii, tile coverage.
M5.performance_note: Default eps2d=0.3 is quality-optimal. No quality-preserving configuration change provides workload reduction.
M5.gt_quality_note: eps2d=0.3 achieves best quality (31.62dB). Quality drops at both extremes.

M6.name: HiGS inference renderer
M6.mechanism: GaussianInferenceRenderer class. Macro-tiles + fine render tiles. Inference only.
M6.note: Inference-only renderer. No backward pass. Cannot participate in differentiable training.

M7.name: HiGS SH compression
M7.mechanism: FP16/FP8 SH coefficient packing for memory bandwidth reduction.

M9.name: TC-GS (Tensor Core)
M9.mechanism: External repository (DeepLink-org/3DGSTensorCore). Tensor Core alpha computation.
M9.note: External repository. Core code not controlled by this project.

C1.name: depth bit-width compression
C1.performance_note: <1% forward speedup on RTX 5070 (within noise). CUB radix sort is NOT the bottleneck.
C1.gradient_correctness: NOT_APPLICABLE (zero risk — backward uses flatten_ids, not isect_ids)

Phase17A.name: intersection_sorting_architecture
Phase17A.mechanism: Structural analysis. Three structural candidates identified (C17-1, C17-2, C17-3). No parameter tuning.
Phase17A.performance_note: Phase 17A source trace + literature recon + candidate design complete.

C17_1.name: tile_local_bounded_queues
C17_1.mechanism: Replace two-pass global materialization + global radix sort with single-pass per-tile bounded buffers + per-tile block-level local sort.
C17_1.performance_note: Phase 17B completed. Feasibility proven (34.8M isects, 9 configs, 0 missing/0 extra). Estimated 1.1-1.5x forward speedup. CUDA implementation deferred.
C17_1.gt_quality: SUPPORTED (pixel equivalence follows from ordering identity)
C17_1.memory_analysis: Uniform queue adds +204 MB. Two-pass exact allocation saves memory.
C17_1.classification: B — Correct, renderer-level optimization likely. CUDA implementation required for speed measurement.

C17_2.name: two_phase_sorting
C17_2.mechanism: Break global radix sort: Phase A (narrow CUB sort for tile contiguity) + Phase B (per-tile depth sort).
C17_2.performance_note: Phase 17C candidate. Informed by C17-1 feasibility results.

C17_3.name: forward_metadata_backward_cache
C17_3.mechanism: Pre-load unique Gaussian attributes into linear cache during forward. Backward reads from cache.

top_3_selection.reasoning: M1 is the ONLY candidate with measurable training benefit (1.22-1.58×). M3 all gates PASS but NOT a performance knob. All other candidates eliminated or non-differentiable. Multiple candidate selection yields 1 valid candidate.
top_3_selection.declared_candidate_status: 1 CANDIDATE REMAINING — correct scientific conclusion despite desire for 3-5 candidates. Retaining invalid candidates would violate advisor requirement 0: '不能为了满足数量要求而保留没有实际价值的优化'.

remaining_evidence_gaps.M1_adaptive_tile_size: Not implemented. Scene-level static oracle works. Adaptive kernel not justified.
remaining_evidence_gaps.M1_multi_gpu_validation: A100 vs RTX 5070 show different tile optima. H100/RTX4090 untested.
remaining_evidence_gaps.M3_quality_gap: View-dependent appearance degradation at SH0/SH1 not fully characterized beyond PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS.
remaining_evidence_gaps.composability_gradient_gap: No module combination worth testing: M2 is NO-OP, M3 is not performance knob, M4/M5 are FALSIFIED.

phase17B_C17_1_evaluation.feasibility_note: Intersection set equivalence proven across 34.8M intersections, 9 configs. Zero missing/extra/duplicate. 100% depth order match.
phase17B_C17_1_evaluation.performance_note: CUDA implementation not completed (6+ files). Estimated 1.1-1.5× forward speedup. Baseline fwd: room t16 7.5ms, bicycle t16 25.9ms.
phase17B_C17_1_evaluation.memory_note: Uniform cap=8192 adds +204 MB for bicycle t16. Two-pass exact allocation drops to -247 MB (saves memory).
phase17B_C17_1_evaluation.overflow_note: Max per-tile isects = 14,174 (bicycle t32). Cap 8192 for tile16: 0-1% overflow.
phase17B_C17_1_evaluation.classification: B — Correct, CUDA implementation required for speed measurement
phase17B_C17_1_evaluation.recommendation: Proceed to Phase 17C (C17-2 Two-Phase Sort). Revisit C17-1 CUDA after C17-2.
